g.text: Retrained configurations: mean ± sample SD across seeds 42–44; frozen RealMLP: one model. Error bars are SD, not CI. X-axes are zoomed.
FPR denominators on Test for G6-only groups: AIAN 77, 2 or more minority races 59, Joint 147. Small denominators limit interpretation; mean differences are not claims of statistical significance.
